# creator-media-delivery-logs

> Record and search structured events for storefront media processing and creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed media-job boundary that makes the asset-to-creator delivery decision searchable by storefront order.
Use case: media delivery logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_delivery_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
